name: Hotel des Indes
positioning: Former town palace on the Lange Voorhout in the royal heart of The Hague, a member of The Leading Hotels of the World
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Binnenhof, the Mauritshuis and Noordeinde Palace
Guests who enjoy a classic High Tea in a historic lounge

facts.text: Hotel Des Indes is located on the Lange Voorhout in The Hague.
The Binnenhof, Noordeinde Palace, the Mauritshuis, Museum Escher in het Paleis and Panorama Mesdag are all close to the hotel.
The Des Indes Lounge & Restaurant serves lunch, dinner a la carte and a three-course chef's menu.
Private dining is available for special occasions.
The Presidential Suite has a bathroom with a steam cabin and a spacious living room.
Many celebrities and heads of state have stayed in the Presidential Suite.
Rooms come with Marie Stella Maris care products and a rain shower.
All rooms and suites are accessible for guests with disabilities, reached by elevator.
Hotel Des Indes is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
Junior Suites have large windows with daylight and a view over The Hague.
The hotel offers event spaces with natural daylight for corporate and private events.

highlights.text: The restaurant's chandeliers, draperies and seating recall the era when Des Indes was a town palace where heads of state were entertained.
High Tea is served daily in the Lounge.
The Presidential Suite has a large balcony with a view of Lange Voorhout and The Hague skyline.
The concierge helps plan bike routes and arranges rental bikes.
The chef's dishes are created from premium products of Dutch origin.

considerations.text: This is a city-centre hotel on the Lange Voorhout, amid the government buildings, palaces and museums of The Hague.
WhataHotel notes a traditional, formal atmosphere that may not suit casual travelers.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
